title: Backyard Worlds: *Australia* leads
hook: Past 83 hours, USA is 13 yards behind with more runners left.

slides.label: What happened
slides.h: Team Worlds is down to a *two-horse race*
slides.c: As of 21 Oct, Australia leads the Backyard Ultra World Team Championship on 1,062 yards. The USA is on 1,049.

slides.label: The numbers
slides.c: Australia has 2 runners left, the USA has 7. Japan (986), Belgium (973) and the UK (926) follow.

slides.label: Why it matters
slides.c: Every yard is a 6.7 km loop run hourly. The USA can bank yards with seven runners, while Australia relies on two. Provisional totals.

caption:
NEWS: Backyard Worlds: Australia leads the team race

As of 21 Oct, Australia leads the Backyard Ultra World Team Championship on 1,062 yards, 13 ahead of the USA (1,049). Australia has 2 runners left, the USA has 7. Totals are provisional.
